news.title: WoW: Forever Continuing to Break Records With Over 15 Million Characters Created
news.description: WoW: Forever continues to break records with over 15 million characters created and almost 1.5 billion quests completed.
news.details:
Announced on X (Twitter), Blizzard announced some brand new statistics for the first two weeks of WoW: Forever's launch.
Characters Created: 15,160,147
Quests Completed: 1,480,343,357
Enemies Defeated: 9,786,925,806
Guilds Created: 140,764
Camping Items Used: 28,696,386
Parties Formed: 71,309,889
Deadlist Boss: Archmage Arugal (Shadowfang Keep)
PvP kill: 28,938,569s
Players Deaths: 196,851,761
Holly Longdale also announced on Twitter that there are more people playing Forever weekly than seen in WoW in 15 years!

news.title: Blizzard Removing Gold and Applying Account Suspensions to Significant Abusers of Blackmaw Hold Farm
news.description: Blizzard will be removing all gold earned from the Blackmaw Hold farm and applying account suspensions to significant abusers!
news.details:
As players continue their journey into WoW Forever’s higher-level content, we are closely monitoring the game economy to ensure that gold sources and costs are well balanced. Finding efficient farming spots has always been part of the game, and is how most players have earned their epic mounts since 2004. When a single location proves so lucrative that it overshadows all other sources, we generally adjust it to bring it in line with the rest.
Over the past weekend, some players discovered a large group of non-elite enemies in the Blackmaw Hold dungeon that were incorrectly dropping the full amount of dungeon loot that would be expected from an elite. Early yesterday, we addressed this with a hotfix, and since then, we have been investigating the overall economic impact.
Players who simply ran Blackmaw Hold a few times and benefited organically from the extra loot did nothing wrong, and…

news.title: WoW: Forever Post Hits #1 on r/all - Many Players Are Very Upset About the Blackmaw Hold Gold Farm
news.description: Players are very upset about the recent gold farm in Blackmaw Hold and how this injection of gold can affect the economy.
news.details:
WoW: Forever was mentioned to be a game about taking your time and enjoying the journey with a brand new start. In an interview with MMORPG, they mention how they are "giving you permission to take your time". But when a massive gold farm injects thousands of gold into the new economy and then gets fixed, it feels very unfair to a lot of players and makes them feel like they should have rushed.
Many players are not level 55+ to enter Blackmaw Hold, but the effects of gold entering the economy will likely be felt by many players. With this amount of Gold, certain players can have full control over markets, such as buying all the Arcane Crystal, and a general increase in Gold can cause inflation on all commodities when the majority of players are still leveling.
Community Reaction

news.title: More Classes, Quest, and Item Changes - WoW: Forever Hotfixes for November 16, 2026
news.description: Blizzard has announced hotfixes for today, which includes a lot of changes for classes, quests, items and dungeons!
news.details:
Hotfixes
November 16, 2026
Camping
The Fishing Rack now provides lures for everyone.
Bloated Fish caught from the Fishing Rack effect have had their drop chance increased and their loot tables adjusted accordingly.
Classes
Druid
Fixed an issue where ranks of Wild Growth were not going on cooldown.
Balance
Fixed an issue where the Genesis talent was not increasing the damage of Pounce’s bleed.
Priest
Fixed an issue where Dark Inspiration was stacking if there were multiple Shadow priests in the same party.
Vampiric Embrace healing is now based on 10% of the Shadow damage done by the casting Priest (was 20%). The casting Priest receives 100% increased healing from this effect.
Developers’ notes: This change results in no difference for Priest solo play.

Rogue Poison ranks can no longer go above the maximum rank.

news.title: New Scarlet Monastery Hearthstone in WoW: Forever
news.description: A new cosmetic Hearthstone has been found in WoW: Forever!
news.details:
Cosmetic Hearthstones are new to WoW: Forever and give your character a unique animation during the 10-second cast time while casting. In WoW: Forever, the first cosmetic Hearthstone has been discovered, Scarlet Hearthstone. This toy goes into your Toy Box, but instead of casting it directly from there, it gives you Scarlet Hearthstone, which still takes up a bag slot.
Here's what the Hearthstone animation looks like.
According to Undyingshaman on the WoW Forums, this item drops from High General Abbendis in the Eastern Plaguelands.
This is the first cosmetic Hearthstone in WoW: Forever and probably won't be the last. What other Hearthstones could be out there?

news.title: 100+ Gold Per Hour Farm Nerfed in WoW: Forever
news.description: The 100+ gold per hour farm in Blackmaw Hold has now been nerfed after some players already generated hundreds, if not thousands, of gold from runs.
news.details:
As players start to level up, they are discovering how to make gold quickly to buy the expensive Epic mount, finish their Professions, and unlock their Best-in Slot Gear. Players discovered the new Weekly quest in Booty Bay that awards up to 100 Gold, but one other way is through raw material farming, and players discovered a very good farm over the last week.
Blackmaw Hold Runs
In Blackmaw Hold, there is a room filled with around 30 Blackmaw Devotee. These creatures are non-elites that only auto-attack, but can drop a lot of loot. This location is a little further in the dungeon, but by mounting through the first area and using the large fall as a clever aggro drop, groups could make this run relatively efficient. Mages can even get to this area solo using locations where mobs cannot path to in order to reset them. Defeat all the mobs, loot them and then reset the run and go again for…
